archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST

typography.rules: H1 up to text-6xl clamp. No center alignment for body text. Dense typography. Playfair Display for editorial massive headings.

visual_enhancers.borders: Hairline borders 1px solid #E5E2DC everywhere to expose the grid math. Brutalist influence with 0px border-radius.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Fade-ins, hover floating photo cards, subtle hover effects, hover inversion (bg/text swap) for links.
visual_enhancers.animations: Framer-motion scroll-reveals, momentum scrolling via Lenis, kinetic masked line-by-line hero reveal, one slow editorial marquee.

grids.philosophy_section: Numbered manifesto chapters, strict grid layout.
grids.menu_section: Digitized interactive menu, filter tabs. Items have allergen badges. Dense list layout.
grids.spacing: Generous spacing. p-12 to p-32. Container borders visible forming a bento-like brutalist skeleton.

layouts.hero: Editorial hero with big serif typographic statement + signature dish photo with hover zoom.
layouts.booking: Sticky floating booking drawer with CoverManager iframe + phone fallback.
layouts.header: Sticky header with logo/isotype + bilingual (CA/ES) switcher + 'Reservar Taula' pill CTA. Backdrop blur with semi-solid background.
layouts.wine_section: Secondary dark surface (#14161B) for wine/evening section, white text.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure dark charcoal text meets APCA on off-white bg. Cobalt blue text/button must contrast properly.

media.image_treatment: Real product photography treated with spotlight/clipped frame styling. Hover zoom on signature dish.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add framer-motion lenis @radix-ui/react-tabs lucide-react
Build the UI in App.js (or relevant component files). Implement the sections sequentially.
Apply hairline borders (#E5E2DC) around sections and grid items to create a brutalist skeleton structure.
The hero section needs framer-motion for line-by-line text reveal of a big serif statement.
Menu section should have functional tabs. Hovering on a menu signature dish row should render a floating photo card using framer-motion or fixed absolute positioning aligned with the cursor.
Booking drawer must be implemented as a Dialog/Drawer (using Radix or framer-motion) with CoverManager iframe placeholder.
Implement bilingual toggle visually (can just toggle text state or simply act as a UI element for design purposes).
Ensure the wine/evening section switches to dark mode styling (bg #14161B, text white).
Create the logo isotype: a cobalt blue circle with two abstract cream figures resembling 'ü'.
